description: This file defines a class `EnterProfileNode` within the Twig Profiler package, representing a node that enters a profiling context in Twig's templating engine. It includes constructor and compile methods for generating PHP code to handle profiling entry points.

classes.name: EnterProfileNode
classes.description: Represents a profile enter node used in Twig's profiling mechanism, encapsulating data related to entering a profiling context and generating corresponding PHP code.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an EnterProfileNode with extension name, type, name, and variable name, passing certain attributes to the parent constructor.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code to start profiling for the given node, using the Compiler object to write code that retrieves the extension and calls 'enter' with a new Profile instance.
